title: Chapter 226: Qi State'S Conspiracy

Chapter 226: Qi State'S Conspiracy

King Yan was silent, his brows were tightly frowned, and the battle between heaven and man was constantly in his heart, should he agree to this decision?

This time, the alliance seems to have a great chance of being formed. The country of Qi has a vast land and abundant resources, with four or five counties.

Moreover, it has a large population, unlike other parts of the world. After years of wars, the population has withered and the land is barren. Now it is the most prosperous country in the world, even the state of Qin cannot compare.

If the State of Yan can take over a part of the country, even if there is only one county, it will have a population of five or six hundred thousand and a land of several hundred miles. This is a very big temptation.

You must know that although the current Yan State has three counties, its population is only over one million, which is only equivalent to one or two counties in Yan State, and its wealth is not as rich.

If he can seize a county of Qi State and digest it, Yan State will have 100,000 more troops from him. And the treasury will have enough money and food, and there will be no shortage of money and food like now, and there will be no food to gather if you want to form a large army.

At the very least, Yan State has a great chance to win Jibei County in the north of Qi State, and even try to get involved in Linzi County.

However, King Yan still had a few doubts in his heart.

"His Royal Highness Prince Jing, although your proposal is very good, and I agree with it, but will other countries agree to this laborious expedition with little profit? After all, they are all very expensive, and will they risk it? One thing!" With worries and doubts, King Yan expressed his confusion.

"You don't have to worry about this king, other countries will definitely agree, and they will even be more anxious than us, especially the two countries of Wei and Zhao!" Zhong Yu was full of confidence, with a look of confidence in all countries.

Seeing the man in front of him with a face full of wisdom beads, very sure, King Yan felt a little suspicious, could he really be sure?

"Then, Your Highness, why did they agree? It seems completely thankless?"

King Yan's words were not wrong. The territories plundered by Zhao and Wei were already large enough. It would take more than ten years to digest them.

Now if you go to covet the territory of another country, it is very likely that you will not be able to eat too much, and instead focus on one thing and lose another, the gain outweighs the loss.

After all, Qi State still has hundreds of thousands of troops and sufficient money and food, which is enough to start a continuous war and drag all countries into the abyss.

"They had to fight. The King of Yan must understand that the Seven Kingdoms, including the Qin Kingdom and the Yu Kingdom, have paid hundreds of thousands of lives for this war.

Such a large sacrifice has greatly weakened the potential of each country, and it is not known how long it will take for the strength to recover.

But what about Qi? His strength is still intact. Think about it, the 600,000 army can set off at any time to invade any country around it. Such a huge force, even the Chu State, which is now more powerful, will be deeply afraid of it!

How could countries allow such a force to sit by his side and ignore it? On the side of the couch, no one else is allowed to sleep soundly. As the king of the superior, it is impossible not to understand this truth! "Such a long sentence jumped out of Zhong Yu's mouth, deeply awakened King Yan, and made him feel horrified.

Yes, the strength of all countries has been weakened, but Qi remains intact. Today's Qi State can already be called the number one country in the world, and even the two big countries of Qin and Chu can't compare with him.

Because the strength of those two great powers has been severely weakened, Qin State now even has thirteen or fourteen-year-old children on the battlefield, and Chu State has also begun to recruit the old and weak.

However, Qi State still has more than 600,000 young and strong people, who are staying firmly on his land, like a dormant giant beast, watching the tired prey around him, waiting for an opportunity to devour them.

Among them, the most frightening thing is the Yan King in front of him. He has not forgotten that Yan State led the six kingdoms to attack and almost wiped out all the kingdoms. Until now, he has not completely recovered his vitality.

Now the strength of Yan State is already the weakest among the countries, and it is on par with South Korea. If Qi State is worried about it and sends him an army of 600,000, Yan State will definitely be destined to win the war. Eagle King The head of the project can't be kept.

"No, absolutely not like this, this alliance must be established, Qi must be fought!" King Yan said in fear in his heart, he was extremely determined to fight Qi at this moment, and he was even thinking about how to persuade himself King Han, let him also join this alliance.

Seeing Yan Wang's face that turned pale instantly, and the cold sweat constantly breaking out on his forehead, his body was trembling a little, Zhong Yu secretly laughed a few times in his heart, after all, he knew he was afraid!

"How is it? Your Highness King Yan, do you think what I just said is reasonable? Now that all our countries have killed their lives, the number of damaged soldiers and horses is one of the best, and half of the world has been destroyed. Can you just sit in a corner? Sit and watch the tigers fight in the world!" Interrupting King Yan's contemplation, Zhong Yu said a word of common hatred and hatred.

Awakened by the words that suddenly rang in his ears, King Yan was a little taken aback, but soon recovered, and said in a joyful tone:

"That's right, that's right, what Your Highness said is, why is Qi Guozheng able to hide behind and sit and watch us fight Qin Guo to death, but he hides behind and enjoys peace!"

"In that case, His Highness has agreed, and is willing to send troops to attack the Qi country together!" A smile appeared on his face, Zhong Yu looked at the King Yan in front of him, and finally let go under his own intimidation.

"That's right, my country of Yan is willing to send out 200,000 troops to attack Qi in the south. If Qi is not destroyed, I will not return to the army for a truce!" King Yan's face was ruthless, and his mouth was even more murderous.

Although Zhong Yu was happy with Yingwan's determination, he didn't have too much hope for his army of Yan State. With the population of Yan State now more than 1 million, what is the quality of the 200,000 army that came out? It's scary to think about it.

I'm afraid that the 200,000 people in the King of Yan will be children of thirteen or fourteen years old, and old men in their seventies and eighties.

"Then our most important goal now is to defeat Qin State first, or at least force him into Hangu Pass, so that he can contribute his strength in Wudong!" Zhong Yu nodded and said with a serious face.

"Your Highness is right, the most important thing now is to defeat Qin, drive him back to Hangu Pass, back to his Longxi frontier, the fertile land of the Central Plains, invaded by barbarians like Zhilong!" It's about my life and death , Yan Wang, who was not active in the face of the alliance, also began to take the initiative.
